I realize the real bug is that `triage`, the customer-facing chat, has no store, causing the session call to fail — I should give it the shared FileSessionStore. I'm now weighing whether orderAgent needs one too, but since client-managed sub-agents without a store get their state seeded automatically, that path already works; adding a store there would actually break history forwarding during delegation.

Checking the triage history-forwarding logic, since orderAgent only receives the task text like "What is its status?", it needs the forwarded conversation context to know what "it" refers to — so orderAgent must stay client-managed with no store, while only triage gets one. The fix is to add a `store` property to the triage agent definition alongside its existing system prompt and maxTurns settings.

This confirms triage is the customer-facing entry point, so if orderAgent got the store instead, triage's history forwarding would break order lookups — meaning triage needs the store, not orderAgent.
